View scenario assumptions

Two visits per customer per month; 30 service minutes and 15 baseline travel minutes per visit; 160 hours per independent crew per month; 20 baseline admin hours, reduced to 10 in the planned scenario. Fuel uses 25 mph equivalent travel speed, 18 mpg and $3.50 per gallon. Growth and efficiency are assumptions, not guaranteed results. Revenue assumes completed, collected visits and excludes expenses. Crew costs are not modeled.
